name: Heroic
description: Heroic’s updater presents an Update/Postpone/Changelog dialog, retrieves only after Update is selected, and asks before restart; the reviewed updater does not establish the claimed hash or OS-signing checks.
limitations: Newly retrieved default-branch snapshot; not historical release re-verification.
External updater-library behavior and released artifact signing/notarization remain outside the cited source unless directly shown.
